integrity: Theorem and underlying LCD construction are credited to Mondal and Lee; projective counts and matching proof are reproduced. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only minimal two-helper sets are counted; the code has locality one due to parallel columns. A general projective incidence proof applies to all n≥2. No transport-performance or absolute novelty claim. Finite exhaustive verification is for n=2,3,4 only.
title: Sharp disjoint recovery availability in systematic ternary simplex LCD codes
